_readme.what: Hand corrections, keyed by listing slug, merged over data/listings.json at build time.
_readme.why: So re-running `npm run import` never quietly undoes a manual fix.
_readme.how: Add a slug key with only the fields you are correcting, e.g. { "caltrop-tribulus-terrestris": { "binomial": "Tribulus terrestris" } }. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_readme.note: Arrays and objects replace wholesale rather than merging element-by-element.
